articles.title: Adelardo, Fernando Torres y Amanda Sampedro asumen la capitanía contra el Bullying
articles.standfirst: Las tres leyendas del Atlético protagonizan la quinta edición de la campaña de sensibilización de la Fundación “Hazte Defensa Contra el Bullying” que ya ha llegado a 4.500 jóvenes
articles.summary: Las tres leyendas del Atlético protagonizan la quinta edición de la campaña de sensibilización de la Fundación “Hazte Defensa Contra el Bullying” que ya ha llegado a 4.500 jóvenes
articles.body: "Somos un equipo, no dejamos a nadie atrás. Todos somos capitanes contra el bullying, hazte defensa contra el bullying" es el mensaje común que Adelardo, Fernando Torres y Amanda Sampedro lanzan como protagonistas de la quinta edición de la campaña de sensibilización que la Fundación Atlético de Madrid lleva a cabo para concienciar sobre el acoso escolar e implicar a la sociedad en la lucha por erradicarlo. De ahí que coincidiendo con el Día Internacional contra la Violencia y el Acoso Escolar, incluido el Ciberacoso, las tres leyendas rojiblancas protagonizaron un vídeo en el que portan el brazalete de capitán contra el bullying y trasladan los valores del fútbol a las aulas, el recreo y la vida en general. “Reconocerlo es el primer paso para poder pararlo”, introduce Adelardo. “Cuando sucede, todos podemos elegir qué hacer. Podemos acercarnos, podemos escuchar, podemos ayudar, podemos pedir ayuda… Pero, sobre todo, podemos no mirar a otro lado”, añade Amanda. “Porque un equipo no se demuestra solamente cuando gana, también cuando protege, acompaña y defiende a uno de los suyos. Esto también es ser capitán contra el bullying”, sintetiza el Niño para poner el foco en la responsabilidad colectiva para poner fin a esta lacra. Cabe recordar que según el VIII Informe de la Fundación Mutua Madrileña y la Fundación ANAR publicado en septiembre de 2026, el 14,1 % de los escolares españoles ha sufrido acoso escolar o ciberbullying, lo que supone un repunte de 1,8 puntos respecto al curso anterior, de ahí que aún queden muchos pasos por dar. A pesar de que desde que la campaña Hazte Defensa Contra el Bullying naciera en la temporada 2021-22 haya conseguido llegar hasta 4.500 alumnos de más de 40 centros educativos y 32 equipos de fútbol. De este modo, la Fundación Atlético de Madrid trabaja en la prevención y sensibilización frente al acoso escolar y el ciberacoso a través de charlas y talleres impartidos por profesionales de la psicología que utilizan los valores del deporte como herramienta de educación, convivencia e inclusión. Además de las visitas a centros escolares, el programa ha ido incorporando más iniciativas, como la entrega del brazalete de Capitán contra el Bullying, símbolo del compromiso de los estudiantes, y la Cápsula del Compromiso, en la que los alumnos depositan mensajes escritos con las acciones que están dispuestos a llevar a cabo para contribuir a erradicar el acoso escolar. El proyecto ha contado, además, con la implicación de jugadores y jugadoras de la primera plantilla del Atlético, de referentes deportivos del baloncesto como Iñaki Zubizarreta e incluso con perros de asistencia, que han contribuido a trasladar a los jóvenes la importancia del respeto, la empatía y la valentía para actuar ante situaciones de acoso.

articles.title: Beñat San José: "Oyarzabal es uno de los mejores jugadores del mundo"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Rayo Vallecano habló sobre el partido ante la Real Sociedad
articles.summary: El técnico del Rayo Vallecano habló sobre el partido ante la Real Sociedad
articles.body: Beñat San José regresará a San Sebastián como entrenador del Rayo Vallecano. El técnico analizó el encuentro ante el equipo que le vio crecer en los banquillos con los medios de comunicación y se mostró muy ilusionado. El conjunto franjirrojo viene de ganar al Celta de Vigo 3-0, mientras que los donostiarras no pasaron del empate a uno ante el Olympique de Lyon. Recuerdo a Jesús De Miguel: "Ha sido una consternación total y absoluta. Ha sido un palo increíble para el mundo del fútbol, ni qué decir para su familia y su club. Lo primero, mandar el pésame y todo el ánimo posible. No tenemos palabras para descifrar el impacto que ha tenido". Disputa de la jornada: "Mi opinión no tiene mucho sentido. Han decidido que juguemos. Considero que tiene que haber un gran homenaje desde todos los estadios de España". Cambios en el equilibrio del equipo: "Estoy muy contento con el resultado del otro día. El trabajar en puntos que hay que mejorar lleva su tiempo. Fuimos más sólidos, presionamos todo lo que pudimos y no asumimos tantos riesgos. El acierto y la pegada fueron claves". Partido especial: "Poder estar con el Rayo es lo más especial. Eso es lo primero. Nos enfrentamos contra un rival y un club de mucha categoría, no te voy a negar que es especial. Es mi casa, es mi ciudad, donde nací futbolísticamente y como entrenador. Conozco a casi todo el mundo. El equipo de toda mi vida. Es muy emocional. Cuando juguemos, hemos analizado a un grandísimo equipo que conozco muy bien y vamos a ir con todo para conseguir los tres puntos". Isi: "Cada vez está con mejor ritmo. Puede ser de la partida. Yo con Isi voy a tener paciencia y el 'timing' exacto que él merece y que necesita". Preparación ante la Real: "Tiene muy buenos jugadores y toque de balón vertical. No solo son buenos en construcción, sino en contragolpes. Tienen a uno de los mejores jugadores del mundo, que es Oyarzabal y una cantera top. Es una de la visita más difíciles que hay en esta liga, pero no vamos a renunciar a nuestra identidad". No nominación de Oyarzabal al Balón de Oro: "Tendría que estar seguro y arriba. Ha demostrado el amor por sus colores. Ni me imagino cuántas ofertas habrá tenido y sigue al pie del cañón. Es el jugador perfecto y soñado por la Real en la cantera". Momento de la Real: "Es el tercer partido que juegan en la semana y pueden hacer más cambios. Tienen gente con piernas frescas de mucha calidad y dos equipos para competir a altísimo nivel". Jorge De Frutos: "Tiene todo para jugar en la selección. Si el seleccionador no lo ha llevado, seguro que lo tendrá en su lista. Necesitamos esa versión de De Frutos para seguir sumando en la tabla". Unai López: "Es fundamental para nuestra idea de juego. Tenemos un centro del campo muy completo. No sólo es un jugador de tener la pelota, sino que hace mejor la idea. Tiene una idea de fútbol muy amplia. Con los compañeros que tiene, está yendo a más. Roba balones, presiona arriba, ordena...Le veo en un pico de madurez espectacular. Hay pocos centrocampistas como Unai en la liga".

articles.title: José Mourinho believes a player of Cristiano Ronaldo’s standing deserved a more fitting international farewell
articles.summary: José Mourinho expresses disappointment over Cristiano Ronaldo's abrupt international retirement, hoping for a more fitting farewell in the future, contrasting it with Lionel Messi's celebrated departure.
articles.body: José Mourinho has expressed regret over the circumstances surrounding Cristiano Ronaldo’s departure from Portugal, saying he hopes the forward’s eventual retirement from football will be marked differently. Ronaldo announced the end of his international career after a difficult period with the national team, bringing a 23-year association with Portugal to a close without the farewell that might have accompanied such a career.Mourinho wanted a different farewell for RonaldoSpeaking to Spanish newspaper AS, Mourinho said Ronaldo’s decision to retire from international football had to be respected, but made clear that he hoped the circumstances of his eventual departure from the game would be different."His decision must be respected, and I respect it. But he has not ended his football career, and anyone who knows him realises that he still has goals he is seeking to achieve in his career."He added:"The only thing I wish for is that the moment of his retirement as a player will be different from his farewell yesterday,"Ronaldo announced his retirement on Thursday, November 5, after a 23-year international career in which he scored 146 goals in 234 appearances. The announcement followed weeks of tension within the Portugal camp, including his disagreement with head coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the team.Ronaldo was left on the bench for Portugal's match against Norway and subsequently learned that he would not start against Denmark. He then left the national team's training camp, prompting disciplinary action from the Portuguese Football Federation, which imposed a 30-day suspension and a fine.His retirement announcement came against that background. Rather than receiving a planned farewell in front of Portugal supporters, Ronaldo confirmed his decision through a video posted on his social media accounts, bringing an abrupt end to his international career.The contrast with Lionel Messi's farewellThe circumstances were different from those surrounding Lionel Messi's recent farewell to Argentina. Just weeks earlier, Messi had played what was presented as his final appearance for the national team in Buenos Aires, scoring in a friendly before addressing supporters at the stadium. Around 85,000 fans were present for the occasion, which became a celebration of his career with Argentina.Ronaldo's departure came without a comparable occasion. His final chapter with Portugal was shaped by the dispute within the squad and the disciplinary action that followed his departure from camp, rather than a farewell match organised to recognise his contribution. Whether Portugal will arrange a separate farewell for the 41-year-old remains unclear, with no plans for a commemorative match or formal send-off having been announced.Mourinho and Ronaldo's history at Real MadridMourinho knows Ronaldo's ambitions from their time together at Real Madrid, where the two Portuguese figures worked alongside each other between 2010 and 2013. They shared 164 matches across all competitions and won the 2011-12 LaLiga title, during a period in which Ronaldo became central to Madrid's attack.Their professional relationship gives Mourinho a particular understanding of the forward's approach to football, and he was unwilling to speculate that Ronaldo might be ready to leave the game simply because he has ended his international career.Ronaldo's immediate focus remains on Al Nassr, where he is continuing his pursuit of 1,000 career goals. He currently has 985 to his name, leaving him 15 short of a milestone no player has ever reached. His international retirement does not change that ambition, with the forward still pursuing the target during his club career.Could Ronaldo become a coach after retirement?Mourinho was less certain when asked whether Ronaldo might move into management once he eventually stops playing. Rather than predicting a second career in coaching, he said it was too early to know what the forward would choose to do."I do not know what to say. It is still too early to talk about that," he replied.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.summary: Para los partidos contra Dinamarca, en casa, el 14 de noviembre, y contra Gales, a domicilio, el 17
articles.body: Vitinha y João Félix encabezan la convocatoria de Portugal anunciada este viernes por el seleccionador Jorge Jesus para los próximos partidos de la Nations League, la primera desde la retirada de Cristiano Ronaldo de la selección. En total, Jesus ha convocado a 28 jugadores para los partidos contra Dinamarca, en casa, el 14 de noviembre, y contra Gales, a domicilio, el 17. Serán los dos últimos encuentros de la fase de grupos para Portugal, actual campeón de la competición, que lidera el grupo A4 y ya tiene asegurada la clasificación para la siguiente fase. Cristiano Ronaldo, de 41 años, anunció este jueves su retirada de la selección portuguesa, de la que es el máximo goleador histórico, tras unas desavenencias con Jesus. Su vídeo de despedida se proyectó en la sala de prensa del complejo Ciudad del Fútbol, en Oeiras, a las afueras de Lisboa, antes de que el entrenador anunciara la convocatoria.

articles.body: Mayúsculo susto el que se llevaron los integrantes de la Peña Celtista de Pontevedra, cuando en la medianoche del jueves vieron que el autobús que los trasladaba de vuelta, desde Vigo, ardía. El hecho tuvo lugar en la autopista AP-9, cuando los aficionados retornaban tras presenciar el partido de Europa League que enfrentaba a los célticos ante el Union Saint-Gilloise. Un problema en el embrague del autobús y el fuerte olor a quemado propició que la conductora del autobús indicase a los ocupantes que abandonasen el mismo. articles.title: Marc Roca, tras su primera llamada con la selección: "Ojalá sea la primera de muchas"
articles.standfirst: El jugador del Betis, de 29 años, se reencontrará con De la Fuente, quien le dirigió en las inferiores
articles.summary: El jugador del Betis, de 29 años, se reencontrará con De la Fuente, quien le dirigió en las inferiores
articles.body: Marc Roca, centrocampista del Real Betis, atiende la que describe como una “noticia maravillosa”: Luis de la Fuente lo ha incluido en la lista de la selección española para la ventana de noviembre. A los 29 años, y con el reencuentro con el seleccionador que lo dirigió en el Europeo sub 21, el mediocentro cumple, según sus palabras, "el sueño de cualquier niño que empieza a jugar a fútbol". Reacción a la llamada: "Muy contento, la verdad. Muy emocionado, porque ha sido mucho trabajo detrás de esta llamada. Muy feliz y ahora, a disfrutarlo". Cómo se enteró: "Acabo el entreno, ha venido el míster y me ha dado la noticia, a mis compañeros también. Después ya me ha llamado mi chica, mi familia, mis amigos, así que muy feliz. Al final llega con 29 años, después de mucho trabajo. Creo que es el sueño de cualquier niño que empieza a jugar a fútbol, así que muy feliz y con ganas de esta oportunidad". El peso del Betis: "Muy importante. Al final, que estemos arriba, que estemos jugando tan bien, no solo en Liga, sino en la Champions, creo que te acerca a poder ir convocado con la selección. Sabemos que el trabajo de un club es lo más importante y después, pues bueno, esto de la selección es un premio que ojalá no sea la primera, sino que sea la primera de muchas". Reencuentro con Luis de la Fuente: "Reencuentro con Luis, con muchos compañeros de aquella selección (sub21), así que con mucha ilusión, con muchas ganas de dar mi mejor versión y a disfrutarlo".

articles.title: Why Jobe Bellingham refuses to wear family name on his England shirt after first senior call-up, unlike brother Jude
articles.summary: Jobe Bellingham opts for his first name on the England shirt, setting himself apart from brother Jude Bellingham, marking his independence as a footballer during his first senior call-up.
articles.body: Jobe Bellingham is set to make his senior England debut after receiving his first call-up from Thomas Tuchel, but there is one detail that will distinguish his shirt from the traditional England kit. While his older brother Jude wears BELLINGHAM above the number 10, Jobe is expected to continue using his first name on the back of his shirt, a choice he made early in his career as he began establishing himself as a footballer in his own right.Why Jobe Bellingham has his first name on his shirtJobe began wearing his first name on the back of his shirt in the summer of 2023, when he moved from Birmingham City to Sunderland in a transfer worth £3 million. The decision was suggested by a coach who had worked with him at both clubs, and Jobe has since explained that what began as a simple preference became part of his identity as a player.Speaking to Borussia Dortmund's official website in June 2025, he said:“When I signed for Sunderland, it was suggested to me by someone, a special coach I had there who I also had in Birmingham," he said."I was still young and thought it was cool to have my own name on the back. It didn’t have any deeper meaning – but it’s become something unique. It shows that I’m going my own way."Some people don’t like it – I don’t care. You can’t follow your goal and listen to everyone at the same time. I only listen to people who know what they’re talking about – not internet critics who just spout nonsense."I just try to get better every day. And my name on my shirt is part of that.”The choice also reflects a desire to build a career independently of the attention that comes with being Jude Bellingham's younger brother. Former Sunderland manager Tony Mowbray made that point in 2024, suggesting that Jobe wanted supporters to judge him on his own performances.“I think he’s trying to create his own identity,” Mowbray said. “He doesn’t want to live off the back of his brother’s name; he wants to be the footballer that he is and show people what he can do.”What will be different about Jude and Jobe's England shirts?England's traditional shirt printing uses a player's surname, which means Jude's shirt carries BELLINGHAM above his number 10. If Jobe followed the same convention, his shirt would also display BELLINGHAM, with the squad number providing the only visible difference between the two from the back.Jobe's preference for his first name avoids that duplication. Rather than sharing the same surname printing as his older brother, he will be identified as JOBE, continuing the practice he has followed since joining Sunderland.Jude, 23, has established himself as one of England's leading players and wears the number 10 shirt. Jobe, 21, is now taking his first step into the senior national team, having impressed at Borussia Dortmund this season. His shirt choice is a small but recognisable distinction between the brothers, particularly as they move closer to the possibility of representing England together.Jobe Bellingham earns first senior England call-upJobe received his first senior England call-up on Friday, November 6, after being included in Tuchel's squad for the upcoming Nations League fixtures against Croatia and Spain. The Borussia Dortmund midfielder has been brought in amid a shortage of options in central midfield.Tuchel explained that Alex Scott was not ready, while Myles Lewis-Skelly, who had featured in all four previous matches, was suspended for the Croatia fixture after picking up a yellow card."We have a slight issue in central midfield as Alex Scott is not ready, Myles [Lewis-Skelly], who played in all four matches, picked up a yellow card and is suspended for the Croatia match, so that leaves us short," Tuchel said.He also pointed to the recommendation of England Under-21 manager Lee Carsley and Jobe's recent form at club level."Lee Carsley is talking highly of Jobe in these weeks and months, so there's an opportunity to join and learn in the first-team. He's in a good run of form for Borussia Dortmund."Jobe has previously impressed under Carsley at Under-21 level, and the senior call-up gives him an opportunity to establish himself in Tuchel's squad.Jude Bellingham's dream of playing alongside his brotherJobe's call-up is also a significant moment for Jude, who has spoken openly about wanting to share the England team with his younger brother. The Real Madrid midfielder said in a video on his YouTube channel in 2024 that playing alongside Jobe for their country would mean more to him than winning trophies."Because we’re a similar age and we’ve played together for so long in the street and on the tufts of grass, to play with my brother for England, that would be the biggest dream of my life,” Jude said.“That would mean more than any of the trophies. Especially if we managed to do it on a consistent basis and play at a major tournament together and win things together. Honestly, nothing would even get close to that. Nothing.”The brothers have played together since childhood, but a place in the same senior England side would take that partnership to a different level. For Jobe, the first-name printing is one way of making his own mark; his first call-up now gives him the chance to do that on the international stage.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: En el Zaragoza, el mejor ataque es su defensa: más goles los centrales que los delanteros
articles.standfirst: Diego González e Iranzo suman más dianas que Espiau y Delgado
articles.summary: Diego González e Iranzo suman más dianas que Espiau y Delgado
articles.body: Se suele decir que el mejor ataque es una buena defensa, pero en el caso del Real Zaragoza es literal porque su zaga es su mejor arma ofensiva hasta el momento. Sus dos centrales, Diego González y Rubén Iranzo, suman más dianas que los dos delanteros centros, Edu Espiau y Joaquín Delgado. Un dato sorprendente. Los arietes acumulan tres tantos, todos ellos gracias a Espiau, ya que Delgado todavía no ha visto portería en Liga. Su único gol ha llegado en Copa del Rey frente al Tudelano. Se suponía que llegaba para ser el titular pero su compañero le ha ganado la partida. Eso sí, ninguno está convenciendo del todo. En cambio, la pareja de centrales tiene enamorada a la afición. Iranzo y Diego González ya llevan cinco tantos entre los dos, los mismos que Jaume Jardí, máximo goleador del cuadro blanquillo. Los dos tantos de Rubo llegaron en el mismo partido, logrando un doblete contra el Atlético Madrileño. Por su parte, Diego ha anotado en tres partidos distintos. Se estrenó ante el Juventud de Torremolinos y ahora ha marcado en las dos últimas jornadas. Dos dianas decisivas. Primero el gol del triunfo ante el Europa, que aunque fue más bien en propia, el colegiado se lo dio a él por rematar de cabeza. Ante el Villarreal salvó al equipo sobre la bocina con otro testarazo en el descuento. No solo están brillando ambos en tareas defensivas sino que están dando puntos importantes en ataque.

articles.title: Ferran Costa: "Ningún jugador está preparado para competir este fin de semana"
articles.standfirst: El Sabadell recibirá a la Real B con el nombre de Jesús de Miguel en su camiseta
articles.summary: El Sabadell recibirá a la Real B con el nombre de Jesús de Miguel en su camiseta
articles.body: "Hay cosas que están por encima del fútbol. Ningún jugador de la categoría está preparado para competir este fin de semana. Es un momento donde hay que pasar por un dolor inevitable. Habría que respetar las fases y no exponer a los jugadores a ciertas situaciones en una semana tan difícil y tan dolorosa. Siempre hay tiempo para hacer homenajes". Así de contundente se ha mostrado este viernes Ferran Costa. El técnico del Sabadell se ha sumado a las voces que reivindicaban la suspensión de la jornada 12 de LaLiga Hypermotion por el fallecimiento de Jesús de Miguel. Ha subrayado la necesidad de priorizar la salud mental "en lugar de llenarse la boca con historias". El entrenador arlequinado también ha señalado la necesidad de revisar y mejorar protocolos. "Lo primero es garantizar la seguridad de los futbolistas y de todos los presentes en los estadios. Dentro de la desgracia hay que abrir un momento de reflexión y de mejora para estar más preparados, para que si se repite una situación así tenga otro final", ha afirmado. Costa ha reconocido que es una situación "durísima" que ha hecho "mucho daño" en el vestuario porque, además, le ha tocado "muy cerca": porque hace dos semanas se enfrentaron al propio Tenerife y porque en la última jornada Quadri Liameed cayó desplomado sobre el césped por un golpe muy fuerte en la cabeza y tuvo que ser evacuado en camilla, después de perder el conocimiento. "Nos salió cara en una situación que también nos puso el miedo en el cuerpo", ha admitido. El centrocampista nigeriano es duda para el partido del lunes contra la Real Sociedad B en la Nova Creu Alta porque aún no ha pisado el césped. Este mismo viernes el Sabadell ha anunciado a través de su presidente, Pau Morilla-Giner, que vestirá el nombre de Jesús de Miguel en su camiseta en el partido contra la Real B. Los arlequinados jugarán con la segunda equipación, de color negro, en señal de luto, con la inscripción porjesus.es en el pecho, para dar visibilidad a la campaña de crowdfunding que abrió el futbolista Fran Sol para recaudar fondos para la familia del delantero del Tenerife. "Hay momentos en los que las palabras no bastan. Hemos decidido responder con hechos. No podemos cambiar lo que ha pasado, pero sí podemos decidir cómo respondemos. Cuando el fútbol se une puede conseguir cosas extraordinarias", ha destacado el presidente arlequinado.

articles.title: Jude and Jobe Bellingham: 'Incredible achievement' as brothers called up to England squad
articles.summary: It may be a surprise to some but Jobe Bellingham's call up to the England senior side has been a long time coming.
articles.body:
It may be a surprise to some but Jobe Bellingham's call-up to the England senior side has been a long time coming.

The 21-year-old's career path has been very similar to that of his 23-year-old brother Jude - England's star player at the World Cup and one of Real Madrid's best players. Both were stars of the Birmingham City academy before big-money moves to the German Bundesliga and England call-ups.

Jobe's debut for Birmingham came at the age of 16 years and 107 days - 69 days older than Jude when he made his first appearance for the Blues' senior side.

The central midfielder then moved to Sunderland and helped them win promotion to the Premier League before joining German side Borussia Dortmund at the age of 19 in a deal worth up to £31m.

Jude also moved to Dortmund when he was 17, before developing into one of the world's best players and joining Real Madrid.

Having one of the best midfielders in the world as your older brother comes with challenges and Jobe has consistently been compared to his sibling.

But the former Sunderland midfielder is his own player, wearing 'Jobe' on the back of his shirt instead of his family name. He said it was suggested to him by a former coach because "it shows that I'm going my own way".

England manager Thomas Tuchel told BBC Radio 5 Live it is "a beautiful story".

"They are both good for each other," he added. "My understanding is they are very close.

"It makes life easier for Jobe to come into camp and know his brother is one of the key players in our team. So, that will hopefully help him, but don't forget he is here on his own merits, and he is not here because of his brother."

Jobe is a different type of player to Jude, sitting deeper in the midfield, but is as physically imposing while still being good on the ball.

He is the current captain of the England Under-21 side, and Tuchel said Young Lions head coach Lee Carsley had been pushing for some time for the younger Bellingham to get senior recognition.

"He's the standout player," said Tuchel. "He's the captain, so the door should always be open for the pathway, always be open for special performances over a long period of time.

"That's what Jobe has done on top of it. He found his way, he found his rhythm with Dortmund. He's had an excellent start to his season, is a regular starter and influential."

England host Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, 12 November before travelling to Madrid to take on Spain on 15 November in this next international break.

With Arsenal's Myles Lewis-Skelly suspended for the first game, and Bournemouth's Alex Scott out injured after shining on his debut in last month's 7-0 win over Croatia, Tuchel said a natural "opportunity" for Jobe had opened up.

"He deserves to make an impression for us," said the German in his news conference after naming the squad.

"It's an incredible achievement for the family and for the brothers. I saw his excitement straight away and his smile.

"He has an open and calm personality. He's one of five players for the central midfield.

"He's a more defensive player than Jude. So strong on the ball, good physique, a big body, a very physical player and can keep possession.

"It's now up to him, but he's excited and happy and eager to impress, and that's the best foundation to have a good camp for him."

Which other brothers have played for England?

If they get on the pitch together, Jude and Jobe won't be the first brothers to represent the Three Lions.

It has been 19 years since Gary and Phil Neville, who both played for Manchester United, last played together for England, and 30 years since they started.

They first played together for England in 1996 against China, becoming the first siblings to do so since Bobby and Jack Charlton 26 years earlier.

Jack and Bobby were both part of England's 1966 World Cup-winning squad.

Bobby was the younger of the two, but made his Three Lions debut first. He went on to win 106 international caps.

Jack, who was not called into the England team until days before his 30th birthday, won 35 caps.

More recently, brothers Nathaniel and Trevoh Chalobah have both played for England, but never alongside each other.

Nathaniel made his solitary appearance as an injury-time substitute in a 3-2 away win against Spain in a 2018 Nations League game.

His younger brother Trevoh, currently a Como defender, made the first of his three international appearances against Senegal in June 2025 and was in England's 2026 World Cup squad.

Jobe has shown remarkable progress since last winter. In the first couple of months, following his move from Sunderland to Borussia Dortmund, he seemed timid, as if he was just trying to avoid making any mistakes. His passes rarely, if ever, caused trouble for opposing defences.

Even Dortmund manager Niko Kovac said at one point that he was surprised how long it might take him to get comfortable in the Bundesliga. But hard work in the gym to build up muscle mass in order to become more explosive and the fact that he received plenty of chances in Dortmund's line-up has helped his development.

In the latter stages of last season, his decision-making was much faster and his intensity seemed higher. Still, Dortmund decided to sign Dutch midfielder Joey Veerman, a specialist at making line-breaking passes, in August.

It meant Jobe's place in the starting XI was far from secure at the beginning of this season.

In recent games, Kovac has employed Bellingham in a more advanced role, as one of the two number 10s behind the striker. In this role, Bellingham drove into the final third with pace and showed intensity during pressing sequences.

His performance in the 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich in the Bundesliga last Saturday was arguably his best since his arrival in Germany.

articles.title: In 2023, Scott McTominay's company provided £1 million through an investment firm run by his fiancée's father for a Portuguese property purchase; three years later, he faces losing his entire investment amid a bitter £2 million High Court battle
articles.summary: Scott McTominay's company risks losing a £1 million investment in a Portuguese property as a £2 million High Court dispute unfolds following the collapse of an investment firm linked to his fiancée's father. Details on the legal battle and its implications.
articles.body: In May 2023, Scott McTominay’s investment company put £1 million towards a property purchase in Portugal, with plans to turn a derelict site in the Algarve into a commercial development. The money was channelled through an investment firm run by his fiancée’s father. Three years later, that firm has collapsed, the property is at the centre of a legal dispute and McTominay’s company is pursuing a £2 million claim in the High Court.How McTominay's investment beganThe transaction dates back to May 2023, when SM Fortress, a company solely owned by McTominay, entered into a £1 million ($1.3 million) facility agreement with Fortress Capital Partners (FCP). The investment firm, operated by Ashley Reading and his daughter Cameron Reading, was intended to act as an intermediary in the purchase of a property in Lagos, in Portugal's Algarve region.McTominay's plan was to acquire a derelict two-storey property and its surrounding land, clear the site and pursue a commercial development. According to the account set out in the legal dispute, SM Fortress intended for FCP to pass the money to a Portuguese company, with the property held in trust rather than treated as an asset belonging to the investment firm.The relationship between the parties was not purely commercial. Ashley Reading ran FCP with his daughter Cameron, who is McTominay's fiancée. The footballer's investment therefore involved a company operated by members of his prospective family, a connection that has become particularly significant since the firm's collapse.McTominay also had additional money invested through the arrangement. Reports put his total exposure at approximately £2.32 million ($3 million), comprising the £1 million facility and a further £1.32 million in funds from his investment company.Fortress Capital Partners collapsesFCP entered administration in September 2023, only months after the Portuguese property transaction. The collapse left approximately 230 creditors facing losses estimated at close to £20 million ($26.3 million).Administrators Begbies Traynor described the firm's business model as having the characteristics of a Ponzi scheme, alleging that money from incoming investors was used to meet earlier obligations and cover existing losses rather than being supported by sustainable investment returns. The firm had attracted investors with promises of substantial returns, reportedly reaching as much as 18 per cent annually.The administrators also raised concerns about money being used in connection with luxury property investments in locations including Dubai and Spain. The collapse prompted a Metropolitan Police investigation into allegations of investment fraud, with the force confirming in 2024 that it was examining the matter.McTominay was not the only high-profile investor affected. Boyzone singer Shane Lynch was also among those reported to have suffered losses, while the administrators warned creditors that recovering their money could prove difficult.Why the Portuguese property is at the centre of the court battleThe dispute intensified after FCP became insolvent and asserted a right to sell the property in Lagos, arguing that the money used to acquire it had been lent by the firm. It also obtained an order preventing SM Fortress from seeking planning permission for the proposed commercial development.SM Fortress disputes FCP's position. Its case is that the investment firm acted as an intermediary and that the property was acquired using funds provided for that specific purpose. The disagreement is consequently about more than recovering money: it concerns who has the legal rights to the Portuguese asset and whether it should form part of FCP's insolvency estate.SM Fortress has now brought a £2 million ($2.6 million) claim against FCP in the High Court. In its response, FCP argued that McTominay's company had no ownership rights over the property and was instead an unsecured creditor, entitled to pursue whatever recovery it could establish through the insolvency process."SMF has no valid claim… over and above whatever rights it may establish as an unsecured creditor," FCP's High Court response stated.If SM Fortress is treated as an unsecured creditor, its claim would be considered alongside those of other creditors rather than giving it a separate entitlement to the property. The company is also pursuing allegations that FCP acted in breach of trust, its rights and a settlement agreement.The wider consequences for the Reading familyThe collapse has extended beyond the dispute with McTominay's company. Cameron Reading, who was a director of FCP between April and June 2021, was ordered to hand over hundreds of thousands of pounds relating to property sales in Dubai and Spain, according to reports. Administrators have also raised concerns about the recovery of assets and the firm's obligations to creditors.For McTominay, the investment has developed into a substantial legal and financial problem while his football career has continued in Italy. The former Manchester United midfielder joined Napoli in August for £25.7 million ($33.4 million) and went on to win the Serie A title in his first season, being named the league's best player.The High Court proceedings will determine the competing claims over the Portuguese property and the money invested through FCP. For now, the £1 million transaction made in May 2023 remains at the centre of a dispute involving a collapsed investment firm, hundreds of creditors and the family of the Scotland international's fiancée.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Kozo Tashima: Gianni Infantino's first challenger for Fifa presidency speaks
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino's first challenger for the presidency tells BBC Sport why he is standing in the election.
articles.body:
Kozo Tashima is under no illusions it will be easy to take down Gianni Infantino - but the first serious challenger for the Fifa presidency says he will draw on his "samurai spirit".

First, the 68-year-old needs to get the endorsement of five member associations around the world.

The honorary president of the Japan Football Association said he has had "good replies" from those he has contacted since announcing his ambition to run in the March elections.

If he achieves the necessary endorsements, the next step is an altogether different proposition - toppling Infantino, who has been in charge of Fifa for a decade and told BBC Sport last month he believed he had the backing of the "vast, vast majority" of world football.

Tashima, who sits on the Fifa Council, acknowledged the scale of the challenge, but wants to bring "good change" to the organisation.

The former footballer says he is driven by disappointment in Infantino's recent actions, surrounding the cancelled suspension of United States forward Folarin Balogun at the World Cup and the abandoned plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors.

In an exclusive interview with BBC Sport, he spoke of why he feels he cannot leave Fifa as it is.

"I know [Infantino] has a lot of supporters," he said. "Now I am alone and my budget is not enough but it is OK. My policy, my philosophy, I have to fight against him with my samurai spirit.

"I would like to make sure that the game of football is safeguarded and to be loved and enjoyed by everybody. We have to review the system in Fifa and build good governance.

"In the uncertain situation of the world, sports - especially football - can present good values like fair play, co-operation, hard work, integrity, and show the model of the society. So, first to review and rebuild good governance and make football accessible for all with the principle of football first."

Japan's Tashima to stand against Infantino for Fifa presidency

Fifa to share 'key documents' over World Cup sell-off plan

Infantino says he is backed by 'vast majority'

Asked how confident he was in his ability to get the five endorsements, he said: "I have confidence. I already asked to some of the member association and [received] good replies so far."

He laughed when asked if he realistically hopes to win the election in Morocco in March, before saying: "Of course, of course yes, I hope I will win. It is not easy."

Tashima's campaign will centre on his philosophy for the role of Fifa president, which he described as one based on the "values of sincerity, soundness, fair play, and integrity".

Regarding the Balogun red-card incident, which involved US President Donald Trump calling Infantino to ask for the ban to be reviewed, Tashima said: "I have never seen the red card and the next game who can play.

"This is, I hope, never happens in the world football. He didn't explain about this issue, how to come and how [it came] to happen.

He added: "Most of the things are not answered yet by Mr President Infantino.

"With my experience in Japan Football Association, Asian Football Confederation, and Fifa, for some more than 20 years, I would like to bring good change if I am elected."

Last month, former Tottenham Hotspur defender Ramon Vega announced his intention to stand as a candidate in next year's Fifa presidential election.

He told BBC Sport he had received "more than five" endorsements, but declined to give details of the identities of the member associations backing him.

All candidates must prove they have played an "active role" in football for two of the last five years. Vega has said he is confident he is eligible to stand for the presidency as a shareholder of a club.

Vega has attempted to run for the presidency three times before but each time has failed to garner the necessary support of five associations.

Tashima can therefore be considered the first serious challenger to Infantino.

articles.title: VfB Stuttgart vs. Werder Bremen preview: Undav and Füllkrug in contrasting form ahead of Topspiel
articles.summary: Deniz Undav's VfB Stuttgart will host Niclas Füllkrug's Werder Bremen in the marquee fixture of matchday 10.VfB StuttgartThe captain's goal drought contribut...
articles.body:
Deniz Undav's VfB Stuttgart will host Niclas Füllkrug's Werder Bremen in the marquee fixture of matchday 10.

The captain's goal drought contributed to Stuttgart's slow start to the season. Undav had found the net twice, but none of those goals came in the league as his poor form led him to miss out on Jürgen Klopp's squad nomination for the second time.

Meanwhile, Ermedin Demirović has been their go-to guy this season, although he was unable to score in the defeat against Galatasaray, who had an unsuccessful attempt to sign the Bosnian striker in the summer. Stuttgart returned to winning ways in Bundesliga on matchday 8 after successive defeats.

The absence of Atakan Karazor and Angelo Stiller in midfield would cause selection issues for Hoeneß, although the former has a slight chance to recover from an injury that forced his early substitution against Galatasaray.

Demirović and Undav started together against both Leverkusen and the Turkish champions, although Hoeneß preferred different playing systems. In goal, Dennis Seimen is expected to return in place of the experienced Fabian Bredlow.

After matching Rudi Völler's club record of scoring in seven successive Bundesliga games, Füllkrug earned a national team call-up by Klopp on Thursday. The 33-year-old leads the scoring chart in Bundesliga, and he already opened a five-goal lead over a certain Harry Kane.

The nine goals from the former Torjägerkanone winner helped Werder Bremen to start the matchday in fifth place after having to fight relegation consistently in past seasons. Daniel Thioune's troops are unbeaten in Bundesliga since starting the campaign with a 4-1 defeat to Freiburg.

Mitchell Weiser suffered another injury setback inside the first 15 minutes in last week's 2-0 win over TSG Hoffenheim, and he'll miss this one at the very least. Eren Dinkci, who scored the second goal after replacing him, is expected to start in the right wing.

Werder Bremen are unbeaten in their last two trips to Stuttgart, although the Swabians did win 4-0 at Weserstadion last season. The last time a game between the two sides ended goalless was in February 2006.

articles.title: Orlando City legend Robin Jansson announces retirement
articles.summary: By Jaime UribarriTRANSFER TRACKER STATUS: RetirementOrlando City defender Robin Jansson has announced his retirement from professional soccer after the 2026...
articles.body:
Orlando City defender Robin Jansson has announced his retirement from professional soccer after the 2026 MLS season, ending a legendary eight-year career with the Lions.

The 34-year-old center back joined Orlando in March 2019 from from AIK Fotboll in his native Sweden. He helped the club lift the first trophy of their MLS era, the 2022 US Open Cup , and reach the 2024 Eastern Conference Final.

Jansson was named captain ahead of the 2024 season amid a historic run that saw him set club records for appearances (263), starts (256) and minutes played (23,050) across all competitions.

He's the longest-tenured player in Orlando City history.

"First, I want to say it's been a pleasure to wear this jersey and fight for this crest. When I signed here eight seasons ago, I didn't know I would be here for that long," said Jansson.

"Together, we set new standards and brought home the club's first trophy of the MLS era. I was proud and honored to be given the captain's armband along the way. I've really enjoyed it and have been doing what I love for so many years at the same club. I have been treated very well during my time here, and it has become a place I can call home and will always be connected to.

"But now it's time to step aside and retire from the game I grew up loving and dreaming about."

Jansson helped guide Orlando to their debut Audi MLS Cup Playoffs appearance in 2020, the first of seven straight postseason berths for the league's longest active streak.

He was also a key member of the Lions side that reached the MLS is Back Tournament Final in 2020 and qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup for the first time in 2023.

The club will recognize and celebrate Jansson following Saturday's Decision Day regular-season finale vs. the New England Revolution at Inter.co Stadium (4 pm ET | Apple TV ).

"Robin will always hold a special place in the history of this club, and for me personally, because he was the first player I signed for Orlando City," said sporting director and general manager Ricardo Moreira.

"From the moment he arrived, he embraced everything this club stands for and grew into one of the most important figures in our history. He is a club legend, not only because of his performances and accomplishments, but because of the person, leader and teammate he has been throughout his time here.

"We love Robin and his family, and we wish them nothing but happiness and success in this next chapter of his life."

articles.title: Liam Coen delivers major praise for Jaguars after Ravens win
articles.summary: Liam Coen praised the Jaguars' preparation following their win over Baltimore, offering another sign of Jacksonville's growing player-led culture.
articles.body:
The Jacksonville Jaguars destroyed their opponent for the second week in a row, defeating the Baltimore Ravens 33-10 in Week 9 on Thursday Night Football. It was an especially notable win considering the Jaguars had a short week with just a few days to prepare.

In his post-game speech to the team, head coach Liam Coen had high praise for Jacksonville and how the players prepared for the game.

"I asked you guys this week to be great teammates, to be mentally and physically tough," he began. "Great job guys, started fast, took the ball, big time drive to go up and then man, you guys just kept — defense, kept holding them, holding them. First half, great job jumping up on somebody, but at the end of the day guys, win is a win and it's about the process that you guys had throughout the week led us to this point."

The Jaguars not only had just four days to prepare, but the circumstances were unusual; Jacksonville lost DaVon Hamilton and Eric Murray, who both had huge roles on defense, for the season, and there was a lot of uncertainty as to what Baltimore would present going into the game.

Both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley were injured in Week 8, leaving undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano to lead the Ravens in his first-ever NFL start. While an untested quarterback would seem to be an easy target, the Ravens still have Derrick Henry, one of the best running backs in the league, to help power the offense.

Jacksonville rose above it all, and Coen was impressed by how well they prepared.

"I promise you, the way you guys prepared, it was the best short week I've ever been a part of," he said. "Hands down, not even close, and so, can't tell you guys how much I appreciate the way you guys worked this week. Turnovers, you guys did so many good things but man, I'm extremely proud of your process this week. I'm extremely proud of that, and I appreciate you, I love you."

Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown, while the defense forced three turnovers and held Baltimore to 10 points, despite the absence of Hamilton and Murray. The Jaguars are now 6-2 and have widened their lead over the AFC South, as well as risen to third in the current AFC standings at the very least.

But the significance of Coen's speech may extend beyond Thursday's results.

Action Sports Jax sports director Brent Martineau, who has covered the Jaguars for two decades, suggested that the coach's comments reflect the development of a player-led culture within the organization.

"Every coach wants a player-led team," Martineau wrote , adding that this Jaguars team appears closer to achieving that goal than any he can recall during his time covering the franchise. While he acknowledged that it's difficult to determine how much of a team's culture is truly driven by its players from outside the locker room, he said Coen's comments suggest Jacksonville is approaching that point. Coen has already been receiving buzz about being named Coach of the Year, and Martineau's take can only add to the argument that Jacksonville's head coach is the best in the league.

articles.title: El abismo entre Mourinho y Xabi Alonso: la intrahistoria de las dos noches en Valdebebas
articles.standfirst: El portugués se 'encerró' a las 3am con su plantilla para unirlos frente al calendario; el tolosarra impuso una concentración.. y acabó regalando dos días libres para frenar el motín
articles.summary: El portugués se 'encerró' a las 3am con su plantilla para unirlos frente al calendario; el tolosarra impuso una concentración.. y acabó regalando dos días libres para frenar el motín
articles.body: La caída de Xabi Alonso en el Real Madrid se fraguó en la gestión de la disciplina interna, abriendo una brecha insalvable con sus futbolistas que terminó costándole el puesto. O al menos fue uno de los factores que marcaron su paso en el club blanco. No fue el único motivo de su salida, pero sí uno de los aspectos que más contribuyeron a deteriorar la relación con la plantilla. Uno de los episodios más significativos llegó en la previa del encuentro ante el Athletic. Alonso decidió que el equipo debía pasar la noche concentrado en Valdebebas, una medida que no sentó bien a varios de los pesos pesados del vestuario. La decisión abrió un nuevo foco de tensión en un momento en el que la relación entre el técnico y algunos futbolistas ya atravesaba dificultades tras el Clásico... y la explosión que llegaría después: "¡No sabía que venía a entrenar a una guardería!", adelantó MARCA el día que todo saltó por los aires. Para rebajar el malestar, el entrenador acabó regalando dos días libres para frenar el motín tras el partido. El Madrid cumplió con contundencia y se impuso por 0-3 en Bilbao. Después llegaron esas dos jornadas de descanso, antes de una semana que terminó con dos derrotas en el Santiago Bernabéu: el 0-2 ante el Celta en Liga y el 1-2 frente al Manchester City en Champions. Los resultados agravaron una situación que ya venía de lejos y en la que también pesaban las diferencias en el día a día. La exigencia de Alonso no siempre encontraba la respuesta que esperaba y los desencuentros en los entrenamientos fueron aumentando. La comparación con José Mourinho permite observar la otra cara de una situación parecida. Tras regresar del desplazamiento a Atenas en Champions, con la expedición llegando a Madrid alrededor de las tres de la madrugada, el portugués decidió que el equipo se quedara a dormir en la ciudad deportiva. El objetivo era evitar desplazamientos innecesarios y permitir que los futbolistas descansaran algo más para entrenar la mañana siguiente de cara al partido frente al Valencia (solo tienen dos días de entrenamiento). El mensaje fue diferente. La concentración no se planteó como una exigencia disciplinaria ni como una demostración de autoridad, sino como una decisión compartida para proteger el descanso de la plantilla ante un calendario exigente. Los jugadores entendieron el propósito de la medida y la respuesta del vestuario fue positiva. "Hemos llegado aquí a las 3am... pero nos hemos quedado, ningún jugador se ha ido a casa para intentar tener un par de horas más de sueño. El feedback de los jugadores es positivo, pero no vamos ahora a dramatizar y mañana estaremos", explicó Mourinho. Ahora, el respaldo del club y la convicción de los futbolistas de que las decisiones responden a un objetivo común hacen que todo fluya de manera diferente.

articles.title: LaLiga adelanta al 2 de diciembre el Barça-Atlético y el Real Sociedad-Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: Barça y Atlético, doble cita en liga en menos de un mes y serán tres en 86 días
articles.summary: Barça y Atlético, doble cita en liga en menos de un mes y serán tres en 86 días
articles.body: LaLiga ha fijado los horarios de los dos partidos adelantados de la jornada 23. El miércoles 2 de diciembre, la Real Sociedad recibirá al Real Madrid a las 19:00, y el FC Barcelona se medirá al Atlético de Madrid a las 21:30. El motivo de adelantarlos está en el calendario de febrero. Los cuatro equipos disputan la Supercopa de España, que se juega en Estambul del 2 al 6 de febrero. Ese fin de semana se celebra el resto de la jornada 23. Para evitar la coincidencia, LaLiga ha sacado estos dos encuentros de esa fecha y los ha llevado a la primera semana de diciembre. Así, Barça, Atlético, Real Madrid y Real Sociedad llegarán a Turquía con esa jornada ya jugada. El efecto más llamativo lo sufren Barça y Atlético, que se verán las caras en liga con solo 24 días de diferencia. Su duelo de la primera vuelta es este domingo 8 de noviembre a las 21:00 en el Metropolitano, correspondiente a la jornada 12. Veinticuatro días después estarán en el Camp Nou para la vuelta. En un calendario normal, el segundo choque llegaría casi tres meses después del primero. La coincidencia con la Supercopa agrava la sensación de repetición. La primera semifinal en Estambul, el martes 2 de febrero, es de nuevo Barça-Atlético. Los dos equipos jugarán tres veces entre el 8 de noviembre y el 2 de febrero, dos en liga y una en semifinal. Con el Real Sociedad-Real Madrid pasa algo parecido: se enfrentarán en Anoeta el 2 de diciembre y volverán a verse el 3 de febrero en la otra semifinal.

articles.title: Dominic Vavassori, la última joya italiana que lidera el retorno a la élite del Palermo
articles.standfirst: A sus 20 años, suma seis goles esta temporada en Serie B
articles.summary: A sus 20 años, suma seis goles esta temporada en Serie B
articles.body: Entre los nombres de la lista de Italia Sub21 para este parón destaca el de Dominic Vavassori (Bérgamo, Italia, 2005). El joven atacante de 20 años, cedido por Atalanta en Palermo, es una de las joyas de esta Serie B: suma 7 goles este curso y es uno de los culpables de que el equipo de Sicilia, entrenado por el 'Pippo' Inzaghi, vaya camino de su acenso a la Serie A. Vavassori es pura polivalencia. Puede jugar como '9' pero también ha crecido siendo extremo o mediapunta en la prolífica cantera de Atalanta. Ahora, bajo el mando de un delantero de época como Filippo Inzaghi, se ha destapado tirado a banda, escoltando al ariete finés Pohjanpalo. De padre brasileño, como otra joya italiana y de Bérgamo como Samuele Inácio (Borussia Dortmund), es una de esas perlas que ilusiona a Italia y a la 'Azzurra'. Como muchos otros jóvenes de su época, Vavassori creció con Ronaldo Nazário, Ronaldinho, Kaká o Neymar como referencias. Sin embargo, pese a los orígenes brasileños, su principal referente no era otro que Leo Messi. En Zingonia, la casa de la Atalanta, aprendía desde la distancia de nombres como Lookman o Luis Muriel, futbolistas tremendamente dotados a nivel técnico y muy polivalentes en el frente de ataque. Un camino que ha seguido Vavassori. La historia de Vavassori es otro ejemplo de globalización: padre brasileño pero adoptado cuando era pequeño por una familia italiana, y de madre polaca. Él mientras, nacido y criado en Italia. De su madre heredó su pasión por la lectura... con Harry Potter y Star Trek como sus principales pasiones. Fantasía que traslada al terreno de juego con un estilo que encandila al público: un 'fantasista' que alterna goles con una desbordante calidad técnica. Italia tiene licencia para ilusionarse.
